description: This Kotlin source file defines theming colors for the Streamly TV experience in an Android application. It contains a data class 'TvColors' encapsulating various color tokens mapped from CSS variables, a default color palette 'DefaultTvColors', and composition local/provider objects for theming with Jetpack Compose.

classes.name: TvColors
classes.description: A data class representing the color palette for the Streamly TV UI, including various surface, background, text, and accent colors along with their 'on' counterparts for legibility.

methods.name: StreamlyColors.default
methods.description: Provides access to the default color theme 'DefaultTvColors' for use within Compose theming.
